title: FaultPrediction
description: Fault classification and anomaly score with explanation. Producer: M4 (Fault AI). Consumers: M5, M6.

anomalyScore.description: Unsupervised anomaly score, 0 = normal, 1 = highly anomalous.

contributors.description: Top contributing features (SHAP or equivalent), ordered by impact.

contribution.description: Signed contribution weight, positive pushes toward the predicted fault.

detectionDelayMs.description: Optional. Time from fault injection/onset to this prediction, for latency evaluation on labeled scenarios.

componentId.description: Optional. Level-3 localization: most probable affected component/subsystem, e.g. 'oil-system'. Omitted when the classifier cannot reliably distinguish a component.

subsystem.description: Optional. Human-readable subsystem label paired with componentId, e.g. 'Lubrication'.

severity.description: Optional. Advisory severity derived from confidence + anomaly score. Absent when faultType is NONE.

evidence.description: Optional. Human-readable evidence lines supporting the fault claim (e.g. 'Oil pressure below expected operating range').

recommendedAction.description: Optional. Suggested next step for the operator/maintenance engineer.

alternativePossibilities.description: Optional. Other plausible explanations the model did not rule out (e.g. 'Oil pressure sensor drift').

requiresHumanConfirmation.description: Optional. True whenever faultType is not NONE — this demonstrator never claims an autonomous, confirmed diagnosis.

operatingConditionOutOfRange.description: Optional. True when M2's operating-envelope check (altitude/ambient temperature) found the source TwinState outside its calibrated range, so this prediction's confidence is reduced accordingly.
